name: luxe-flux
description: Luxe Flux — The $29,980 Match-3. A satirical match-3 game about luxury consumerism, built Mobile-First with Capacitor native-ready support.

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:run: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
scripts.ios:run: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap run ios
